title: Carbon-coated niobium tungsten oxides as new and efficient anode materials for Na-ion batteries
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00374A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Y. Bhaskara Rao, Katta Vamsi Krishna, C. André Ohlin
TTB-type, niobium tungstates, Nb18W16O93(NWO) and Nb7W10O47(WNO), are presented as new anode materials for SIBs. NWO showed a reversible capacity of 163.95 mA h g−1 at 10 mA g−1, and WNO delivered a high capacity retention of 81% over 420 cycles.
